basic_details.job_title: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Computer Science & Engineering, IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, has invited online applications for one ANRF - Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post under the sponsored project "EchoPulse: A Self-Supervised and VR-Enabled Mechanism for Automated Cardiac Performance Analysis". The project runs for a maximum of three years or till the end of the project, whichever is earlier. The fellowship is INR 37,000 + 20% HRA per month for the first two years. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: B.E./B.Tech. or M.E./M.Tech./M.S. in Computer Science and Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or allied disciplines from a recognized university/institute. Age: 35 years, with relaxation as per the norms of the Government of India / IIT (ISM) Dhanbad. The notice prints no date for counting age. Hands-on experience in Deep Learning, Self-Supervised Learning, Vision Transformers, Contrastive Learning, and Spatiotemporal Modeling. Proficiency in PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, MONAI, and medical image processing frameworks. Knowledge of Explainable Artificial Intelligence (SHAP, Grad-CAM), uncertainty quantification, and physics-informed neural networks. Familiarity with 3D medical image reconstruction, Virtual Reality (Unity/Unreal Engine), and interactive cardiac visualization. The notice asks applicants to attach a GATE/NET/National level examination qualification certificate among the supporting documents. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is (37,000 INR + 20% HRA)/month for the first two years and (42,000 INR + 20% HRA)/month for the third year. The 42000/- INR fellowship in the third year will be awarded after successful assessment. The project tenure is a maximum of three years or till the end of the project, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF - Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice describes the role as follows: Develop self-supervised learning frameworks for echocardiographic video analysis, incorporating spatiotemporal feature extraction, contrastive learning, vision transformers, and cardiac motion estimation. Implement automated segmentation, myocardial strain estimation, ventricular volume quantification, and ejection fraction prediction using deep neural networks. Integrate physics-informed constraints, uncertainty quantification, and explainable AI methodologies (SHAP, Grad-CAM) for clinically interpretable predictions. Develop VR-enabled interactive 3D cardiac visualization, conduct cross-dataset validation, and evaluate model robustness using clinically relevant metrics. Contribute to research publications, technical documentation, and project deliverables.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF - Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Candidates are requested to fill the online application using the link provided in the notice, by 30 November 2026. They must attach all supporting documents. Documents named in the notice: Supporting documents Copies of publications Awards Recommendation letter CV with photo GATE/NET/National level examination qualification certificate

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their merit and as per the requirement of the project. Mere possession of the minimum qualification does not guarantee an invitation to the interview. Shortlisted candidates will be notified of the date of interview. The interview will be conducted via video conferencing, and a link will be shared with the shortlisted candidates in due course.
